governing_rules: Zero fabricated measurements, datum shifts, or sign flips
Mandatory temporal holdout and colocated well verification

meghalaya_umling_byrnihat.reported_issue: Sensor fault codes (999.0m, 99.0m) and abrupt depth jumps.
meghalaya_umling_byrnihat.investigation_result: CGWB manual records in ML_2021_2025.csv for Byrnihat show physical depths between 1.27m and 3.15m bgl. 999.0m is standard IMD/hydrological missing-value flag / fillValue. Bundled contrast series in contrastHistoricalSeries.json for blk_umling jumps from 2.6m to 23.37m and is already flagged 'untraceable_generated' in historicalSeriesProvenance.ts. Failing closed: excluded from inference.

tamil_nadu_coimbatore_mixed_wells.reported_issue: Mixed shallow/deep aquifer well series in P.N.Palayam.
tamil_nadu_coimbatore_mixed_wells.investigation_result: CGWB regional data reveals two distinct well sites in P.N.PALAYAM block: 1) 'Tamil Nadu::Kalviramapalayam' with water levels between 44.37m and 62.20m bgl. 2) 'Tamil Nadu::P.N.palayam' with water levels between 0.35m and 16.55m bgl. These represent distinct aquifers/depth zones (deep fracture vs. shallow unconfined). Averaging or concatenating them into a single continuous time series produces false discontinuities (>40m artificial jumps). Distinct well series must remain unmerged.

reasons: Temporal aggregation mismatch: point 6-hourly vs. seasonal quarterly manual datum.
Unquantified sensor drift and casing datum offsets.
High diurnal and pumping noise in high-frequency telemetry vs. stabilized recovery readings in manual CGWB surveys.

primary_blocking_factors: Absence of concurrent manual ground-truth pairs within 48h window
Unverified sensor installation depths and transducer datums (Telangana negative values)
Aquifer zone disparity between shallow and deep boreholes
